_comment: SecLoop attack-command registry. One entry per attack mode; only 'sqli' ships. The command is rendered by battlefield/soc/red_team_controller.py, which runs it on the red VM as: cd <workdir> && timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15 <SOC_ATTACK_TIMEOUT_S> <command>. Contract: battlefield/attacks/sqli_lab.py prints exactly one '[RESULT] {json}' line (docs/INTERFACES.md section 2.1). Keys starting with '_' are comments and are ignored by the loader.

sqli.description: Time-based blind SQL injection against the SecLoop lab target (5 weighted stages).
